name: Brains
summary: How smart and observant your Ghostbuster is.
high: Brains 5+ do calculus in their heads, write bug-free code the first time, and speak foreign languages like a native.
low: Bozos watch Lost in Space reruns and have a hard time remembering their own names.
covers: In Ghostbusters, all smart folks know lots about lots of things — history, biology, chemistry, physics, linguistics, trivia and the occult — plus perception. Your Brains Talent is your particular specialty.

name: Muscles
high: Muscles 5+ rip phone books in half, intimidate punks at a glance, bite the caps off beer bottles, and throw bureaucrats into the garbage.
low: Weaklings get their tongues caught on postage stamps.
covers: Hand-to-hand fighting (Brawl, Grapple), lifting, breaking, climbing and intimidation — and roughly how much gear you can lug around.

name: Moves
summary: How dexterous and physically adept your Ghostbuster is.
high: Moves 5+ are better at shooting proton packs, catching, dodging, driving, picking locks, juggling and creeping along ledges — and they flirt, disguise and dress up well.
low: Maladroits get things caught in their zippers.
covers: Firing weapons (including proton packs), dodging, driving, sneaking, disguise, and general physical finesse.

name: Cool
summary: How bold, brave and brassy your Ghostbuster is.
high: Cool 7 keeps its pace even showing up at a black-tie ball in a chicken suit — Cool people have aplomb and know their own capacities.
low: A Ghostbuster with Cool 1 calls the FBI when his toilet backs up.
covers: Nerve under pressure, fast-talk and persuasion (Bluff, Convince, Fast Talk), bargaining, and resisting a ghost's Terrorize.
